title: Read unknown, current and historical stellar intelligence
description: Four independent commanders enter through authenticated controls. Actual leased ticks acquire private observations; a missed scan retains historical facts. Fixed catalogue, domain clocks and scan entropy identities are explicit harness controls, not injected reports. Development scanning rules remain under review. Managed encryption, random-map fairness and hosted scheduling are not certified.
